Storyline.content: Running a fleet is hard enough, and keeping every vehicle legal on the road makes it harder. Fines are now issued by cameras and online systems, often without the driver or the company even knowing, and they keep piling up across every state a vehicle drives through. One expired document can stop a vehicle, cancel a trip or leave an accident without insurance cover. Still, most fleets track all of this by hand. Registration, insurance, licence and pollution certificates sit in different folders, expiry dates sit in spreadsheets, and someone checks challans one website at a time when they get a moment. Vendor and leased vehicles are even harder, because the company carries the risk but does not hold the papers. So renewals get missed, wrong licences slip through, and challans show up only when the bill is already big or a vehicle has been stopped. Fleetsure keeps all of it in one place. It stores every vehicle and driver document and checks each one against government records, so a fake or wrong document is caught early. It reminds the team before anything expires, so no vehicle runs on a lapsed paper. It brings challans from every state onto one screen, so fines are seen and paid before they grow. It treats vendor and leased vehicles the same as owned ones, and gives managers simple reports on where the fleet stands and how much it is spending on fines. Fleetsure does not replace the fleet team. It does the checking for them, so they only step in when something needs attention. With Fleetsure, a fleet knows every day that its vehicles are legal, and stops paying for fines it never saw coming.

FAQ 2 - Question.content: Is Fleetsure a GPS or telematics tool?

FAQ 4 - Question.content: How does Fleetsure track vehicle documents?

FAQ 7 - Answer.content: Fleetsure pulls challans from every state onto one screen, grouped by state and by vehicle, with a running total. The team sees new fines early, settles them before they grow, and can report challan spend across the fleet.
